items.title: Gemini 4 Argon — Google's new frontier model gets a 1M-token output limit

items.title: Pi 0.99 — the minimal coding agent adds MCP and a codemode sandbox

items.title: Claude Code 2.1.285 — a switch to turn off WebFetch and a --desktop handoff

items.title: ChatGPT Space and Pages — OpenAI's shared workspace for teams and agents

items.title: Wes Roth — 'ASTRA 6.1 too dangerous to be released...'

items.title: Fireship — 'DHH has gone completely off the rails...'
